s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.content: Welcome to Dubuu. These Terms and Conditions govern the use of our platform, including all associated services and features. By accessing or using Dubuu, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you may not access or use our services.

s2.title: 2. Definitions
s2.content: For the purposes of these Terms and Conditions, the following shall mean: 'Service': All functionalities, tools and content offered through the Dubuu platform. 'User': Any person who registers, accesses or uses the Service. 'Account': The personal registration that allows the User to access specific functionalities of the Service. 'User Content': Any information, data, texts, photographs, graphics, messages or other materials that Users send, post or display on the Service. 'Personal Data': Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

s3.title: 3. Account Registration and Security
s3.content: To use certain features of our platform, you may need to register and create an account. We use Clerk for user authentication, which provides an additional layer of security. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your access credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. We implement security measures such as data encryption and SSL certificates to protect your information.

s4.title: 4. Phishing and Security
s4.content: Phishing is a fraudulent practice where scammers attempt to obtain sensitive information by posing as trusted entities. Dubuu will never request sensitive information through unsolicited emails or messages. Despite our efforts to keep the platform secure, we are not responsible for phishing activities or data theft carried out by third parties who may impersonate our identity.
